abstract: # P3: Probabilistic Propagation in PPO with VAE for Humanoid Locomotion **P3** is a humanoid robot reinforcement learning locomotion control project based on Isaac Lab and RSL_RL. ## Dependencies This project depends on the following environments and libraries: - **Linux 64-bit**: Ubuntu 20.04 or higher is recommended. - **Python 3.11**: Ensuring compatibility. - **Isaac Lab**: Please refer to the [Isaac Lab Installation Guide](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html) for installation. This project is based on Isaac Sim 5.1.0 and Isaac Lab v2.3.0. - **RSL_RL**: Used for the implementation of reinforcement learning algorithms. ## Usage The training process of this project is divided into two phases: moment matching and Latent Space Fine-tuning. ### 1. Training The first phase uses `sample_times = 1` for training. **Configuration Check**: Ensure the parameters in `source/g1_locomotion/tasks/manager_based/g1_locomotion/agents/p3_rl_ppo_cfg.py` are set as follows: **Run Command**: This script will perform training for 15,000 iterations. ### 2. Finetuning The second phase builds upon the initial training by increasing the number of samples for finetuning to enhance the robustness of the policy. **Configuration Modification**: Please modify the `source/g1_locomotion/tasks/manager_based/g1_locomotion/agents/p3_rl_ppo_cfg.py` file: **Run Command**: This script will load the model checkpoint from the initial training and perform finetuning for approximately 1,500 iterations. > **Note**: `run_finetune.sh` is designed by default to load previous run results. Please ensure that the `--load_run` and `--checkpoint` parameters in the script match the actual path and filename output from your first training phase. ### 3.
